clean-reference.summary: The corrected items scenario on an app that keeps its items after a failed refresh.

capture-too-late.summary: The app opens the list as the page loads, so the capture starts after the content arrived.

endpoint-mismatch.summary: The jobs scenario names the status read, but the list on screen comes from another read.

unavailable-runtime.summary: Nothing answers on the scenario's debugging address: the runs cannot do their work.

incomplete-evidence.summary: The content selector matches nothing on the screen, so the capture never sees the content.

inconsistent-runs.summary: The status read answers Done and Running in turn, so the runs of one build disagree.

legitimate-empty.summary: An inbox with no messages shows its empty state; the empty result is not a finding.

defect-still-detected.summary: The corrected items scenario on an app whose failed refresh clears the items: it still shows the defect.
